title: St Michael's Church, Songyae

buildingCutout.basis: The named timber church roof envelope. The detached bell tower is retained outside the cutout.

terrainReference.basis: Original Mapzen terrain at the timber porch entrance. Roof shape and porch stair dimensions come from the photograph.

identities.name: St Michael's Church, Songyae
identities.address: Ban Nong Songyae, Kham Toei, Thai Charoen District, Yasothon Province, Thailand

mapIdentity.scope: The named mapped roof envelope, approaching paths and the provincial dimensions establish the plan. The current mapped roof is wider and slightly longer than the 16 by 57 metre documented structure.

note: The original front view establishes a tall dark timber shingle roof, ochre main gable, gold-carved lower gable, open porch, white gridded screens and a detached open bell tower to the left. Lengths, tier heights and trim depths beyond the documented building size are visual estimates.
